definitions.explanation: An authentic item as opposed to a fake or imitation.
A person with genuine skill or talent.

examples.japanese: この{絵|え}は{本物|ほんもの}ですか、{偽物|にせもの}ですか。
examples.english: Is this painting genuine or fake?

examples.japanese: {本物|ほんもの}の{味|あじ}を{知|し}っている。
examples.english: I know the taste of the real thing.

examples.japanese: この{時計|とけい}は{本物|ほんもの}そっくりだが、{実|じつ}は{偽物|にせもの}だ。
examples.english: This watch looks just like the real thing, but it's actually a fake.
examples.notes: 本物そっくり = just like the real thing

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{本物|ほんもの}のプロだ。
examples.notes: Figurative usage for a skilled person

examples.japanese: {何年|なんねん}も{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けてきた{彼女|かのじょ}こそ、{本物|ほんもの}の{実力|じつりょく}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: She, who has continued to work hard for years, is the one with genuine ability.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{練習|れんしゅう}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えてこそ、{本物|ほんもの}の{選手|せんしゅ}になれる。
examples.english: Only by overcoming tough training can you become a true athlete.

notes:
USAGE: {本物|ほんもの} can refer to physical objects (authentic items) or people (genuine experts).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本物|ほんもの}の〜 (genuine ~, real ~)
・{本物|ほんもの}かどうか (whether it's real or not)
・{本物|ほんもの}そっくり (just like the real thing)

ANTONYM: {偽物|にせもの} (fake, counterfeit)

RELATED:
・{本当|ほんとう} (truth, reality)
・{正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい} (authentic, genuine)
